source: Long real-DQMC benchmark against the beta=1.4 ED result in temp/benchmark.txt.

normalization.ed_total_NE: ED script accumulates NE = NE_b + NE_c.
normalization.dqmc_total_NE: Use mean(num_up) + mean(num_do) for the Monte Carlo run.
normalization.ed_total_kinetic: ED kinetic operator includes both b and c hopping layers.
normalization.dqmc_kinetic: DQMC file kinetic includes both flavors and is divided by Lq, so compare mean(kinetic) * Lq.
